subtitles.en: How much would a 25 basis point rate hike affect your appetite for risk assets?
subtitles.zh: 加息25个基点对风险资产需求影响有多大？

subtitles.en: You know, you're sort of intimating it a second ago. I don't really think it's a huge issue for the appetite for risk assets. Risk assets, you know, whether we're talking about equities or
subtitles.zh: 你刚才也提到了，我认为这对风险资产需求不是大问题。风险资产，无论是权益资产还是信贷，更多取决于盈利和信贷质量。

subtitles.en: credit, is much more about what's going on, again, on that earning side or on the credit side, on the credit quality side. This is exceptionally strong credit markets. Its widespreads are very tight
subtitles.zh: 当前信贷市场异常强劲，利差处于历史低位。25个基点不会改变这一点。

subtitles.en: historically. And 25 basis points isn't going to change that. Now, what is changing that is the inflation outlook, because what's driving the Fed here to contemplate increases in rates is
subtitles.zh: 真正影响市场的是通胀预期，因为美联储考虑加息是因为实际利率下降而通胀上升。

subtitles.en: that their real interest rate is going down as inflation is going up, and that's making it worrisome that if they don't do something that they're actually contributing to not a neutral rate,
subtitles.zh: 如果不采取行动，可能不仅不是中性利率，反而是刺激性利率。

subtitles.en: but actually a stimulated rate. And if inflation does go back down as well as sort of intimating, you know, we saw in the last two reports, and that continues, then the Fed doesn't have to do
subtitles.zh: 如果通胀如最近两份报告所示回落，美联储可能无需行动。

subtitles.en: anything. So it's about the intersection of the inflation trajectory and the Fed's response here, more than the 25 basis points. I think Stan Jeff, I know it can change on Friday when we get
subtitles.zh: 关键在于通胀路径与美联储反应的交叉点，而非25个基点本身。周五CPI数据可能改变预期。

subtitles.en: the CPI print, but as it stands, best guess right now for you, Jeff. You and your colleagues, Haikohol. You mean Haikohol for September? I mean, luck, it's all conditional on that, on that
subtitles.zh: 目前最佳猜测是九月CPI？这取决于通胀报告和能源价格走势。

subtitles.en: inflation report, as well as conditional on kind of what the Ford looking trajectory is coming from energy prices. So, you know, it really is very, very data dependent, and so it's really a
subtitles.zh: 所以非常依赖数据，真的需要看数据。
